chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn al-Husayn ibn Yusuf al-Baghdadi narrated that Ali ibn 'Anbasa narrated that al-Hasan ibn Sulayman al-Malti, in the place of martyrdom of Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him), narrated that Muhammad ibn al-Qasim ibn al-Abbas ibn Musa al-Alawi in Ibn Hubayra's palace, and Darim ibn Qubaysa ibn Nahshal al-Nahshali, narrated that Ali ibn Musa ibn Ja'far (peace be upon him) narrated from his father, from his forefathers, from Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him).

He said: The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said, 'O Ali! I asked my Lord for anything I asked Him for myself, except that He said, There will be no Prophethood after you. You are the Seal of the Prophets, and Ali is the Seal of the Trustees.'

key_terms.أَبَاهُ: His father (referring to the chain of narration)

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of Ali being called the Seal of the Trustees in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida* highlights the divine reciprocity between the Prophet and Imam Ali, affirming Ali as the 'Seal of the Trustees' (Khatam al-Awsiya) following the finality of Prophethood. It underscores the continuity of divine authority (Wilayah) after the cessation of revelation, a key concept in Shia theology regarding the Imamate's infallible guidance.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 31-339 Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Al-Husayn ibn Yusuf al-Baghdadi narrated that Ali ibn Muhammad ibn Anbasa quoted on the authority of Al-Hassan ibn Soleiman al-Malti in the place of martyrdom of Ali ibn Abi Talib (a.s.), on the authority of Muhammad ibn Al-Qasim ibn Al-Abbas ibn Musa al-Alawi in Ibn Hobayra’s palace, and Darim ibn Qabaysa ibn Nahshal an-Nahshali that Ali ibn Musa ibn Ja’far (a.s.) quoted on the authority of his father (a.s.), on the authority of his forefathers (a.s.), on the authority of Ali ibn Abi Talib (a.s.)

that God’s Prophet (S) said, “O Ali! I asked God for you whatever I asked Him for myself, except for Prophethood since God has said, There will be no Prophets after you. You are the seal of the Prophets, and Ali is the seal of the Trustees.”
